name: Hotel Revenue Report
purpose: Calculates room revenue per hotel per night, split by guest country

inputs.booking_ref: Booking reference the hotel gave the guest
inputs.guest_email: Email address of the guest who stays in the room
inputs.guest_country: Country the guest comes from, as a 2-letter code
inputs.check_in_date: Date the guest arrives at the hotel
inputs.nights: Number of nights the guest stays
inputs.room_rate: Price of the room for one night, before tax
inputs.booking_total: Total amount charged for the booking, including tax
inputs.hotel_name: Name of the hotel the booking is for
inputs.room_type: Type of room booked, such as King, Twin or Suite
